parsed.review_summary: The corrected rationale properly addresses all three error targets: it recognizes that lack of a specific section/figure reference doesn't automatically mean the comment is unspecific (rubric_misapplication), correctly identifies that the evaluated comment does specify what is wrong (factual_error), and avoids stating a numeric score while describing the correct rubric mapping (score_mapping_error). The rationale preserves the valid observation that the comment lacks a specific reference and adds accurate descriptions of the comment's content without inventing evidence. It is coherent and suitable for downstream rescoring.
